messages:
alex: Heads-up team 1: morning APAC spike is pushing up lead routing latency. Seeing round-robin assign to US owners even when timezone mismatch. We need a short-lived fix before the webinar surge.

chen: Saw it too. Looks like HubSpot's assignment rule priority is misordered after last week's update. The "time-window" rule is below the generic rr rule now.

lina: Proposal: temporarily add a "timezone-lock" action in the workflow that sets owner = regional_rr if local_business_hours = true else owner = overflow_apac. This keeps enterprise-exempt.

junior-sales: For clarity: what happens to enriched fields? We rely on enrichment for domain match to decide AE vs SDR. If we route to overflow without enrichment AEs might miss high-ACV leads.

alex: Good catch. Short-term: carve enterprise by form field `company_size` > 500 or known corp email domain via quick lookup. If unknown, route to overflow but tag `needs_quick_review`. Enrichment job still runs async.

chen: Workflow pseudo-rule: 
```
IF lead.source IN (demo, inbound)
AND lead.geo = APAC
AND lead.account_tier != enterprise
THEN set owner = overflow_apac
SET property: enrich_status = pending; quick_review = true
Webhook -> async_enrich_service
```

lina: Canary: 10% of APAC for 3 hours, monitor handoff_time P95, enrich_latency P95, and AE false-negative rate (hits where enterprise was misrouted).

junior-sales: Can we have an immediate Slack alert if any lead with `company_size` > 2000 goes to overflow? Need to catch big deals.

alex: Yes. Add a conditional webhook that posts to #sales-ops when company_size > 2000 or email domain in our whitelist.

chen: I'll reorder the assignment rules in HubSpot and create the `timezone-lock` workflow with enrollment triggers. I'll keep the old rule as backup.

hubspot-bot: Workflow created: timezone_lock_apac_canary (id: wf_2026_091). Enrollment criteria saved.

lina: Dashboard items: add card for APAC assignment by owner region, enrich_pending count, and leads flagged quick_review.

alex: Action items: chen to enable 10% canary flag; lina to add dashboards; junior-sales to draft SDR note; alex to run the backfill script for misassigned owners after the canary. Meeting at 11:00 PT to review.

chen: Flag ON. Starting enrollment. Will post 30m snapshot.

hubspot-bot: Enrollment count: 28 leads (10%) enrolled in first 15m.

lina: First snapshot: handoff_time P95 = 5.8m, enrich_latency P95 = 9.3m. No enterprise misroutes yet.

alex: Cool. If we stay green after 3 hours, ramp to 35% and then full. Keep rollback plan ready.

junior-sales: Noted. Will watch #sales-ops for big-deal alerts.

alex: Thanks all, closing here. Follow-ups in the doc (link) and meeting. :thumbsup:
